presentation_prototype.boundary_geometry: Sourced current Survey of India village polygons; 2018 concordance unverified
presentation_prototype.scenario_values: Synthetic deterministic illustration: impact index, baseline, local author/post counts, digital access proxy, location-confidence proxy, and candidate scores
scenario_rules: Synthetic baseline authors/day are generated deterministically and are not observed platform activity.
Synthetic expected event voices = baseline authors/day × (1 + 1.8 × modeled impact index) × a 5-day illustrative window.
Synthetic observed voices use a deterministic activity multiplier that partly varies with a synthetic digital-access proxy.
Illustrative gap score = modeled impact index × (1 − simulated observed/expected voices), scaled 0–100.
Candidate rule for this demo: impact index ≥75 and simulated observed voices ≤40% of modeled expectation; not a calibrated threshold.

census_2011_source_review.reason: Census 2011 population and area are kept in a separate historical covariate file; a code match does not establish that 2011, 2018, and current polygon boundaries are identical.
